# WorldAtlas

> > WorldAtlas is a comprehensive geography and cartography resource providing maps, country data, continental information, and educational content about the world's geographic features.

Founded by John Moen and operated by Reunion Technology Inc., WorldAtlas serves as a leading educational platform for geographic information, featuring detailed maps, country profiles with flags and ISO codes, demographic data, and expert-authored content on continents, countries, and geographic phenomena.

## Key Topics

- Geography education
- World maps and cartography
- Country profiles and flags
- Continental information
- ISO country codes
- Population and GDP data
- US states and postal codes
- Geographic reference data
- Educational geography content
- World geography resources
- Geographic data visualization
- Country comparisons
- Regional geography

## Geographic Reference & Maps

- [List of Maps with Flags and Country Codes](https://www.worldatlas.com/maps): Complete country reference with flags, ISO codes, GDP, and population
- [Continents Of The World](https://www.worldatlas.com/continents): Overview of 7 continents: Asia, Africa, Americas, Europe, Australia
- [USA States (Two-Letter Abbreviations)](https://www.worldatlas.com/geography/usa-states.html): US state abbreviations and USPS postal codes reference guide

## About WorldAtlas

- [About Us - WorldAtlas](https://www.worldatlas.com/about): About WorldAtlas, founded by John Moen, a leading geography website
- [WorldAtlas.com](https://www.worldatlas.com/about.htm): Company info for WorldAtlas by Reunion Technology Inc. and team
